postings.title: Data Scientist
postings.description:
At M&G, our purpose is to give everyone real confidence to put their money to work. With a heritage dating back more than 175 years, we have a long history of innovation in savings and investments, combining asset management and insurance expertise to offer a wide range of solutions. 

Our two distinct operating segments, Asset Management and Life, work together to provide access to balanced, long-term investment and savings solutions.

Through telling it like it is, owning it now and moving it forward together with care and integrity; we are creating an exceptional place to work for exceptional talent.

We will consider flexible working arrangements for any of our roles and offer workplace adjustments to ensure you have the support you need to succeed in your role.

The Role:
This role is responsible for designing, building, and optimising data solutions that enable reliable and efficient access to data for use in actuarial modelling and assumption setting.
Operating at an Experienced Colleague level, the role provides specialist expertise in data science, ensuring scalable, high-quality data pipelines and processes are in place to support the use of policyholder data for actuarial modelling and assumption setting.
They will use their technical depth, financial domain awareness and delivery experience to lead the design and build of data workflows, drive process reengineering and transformation as well as embed the surrounding controls required for audit and risk assurance. They will apply machine learning and advanced analytics where they add measurable value. They will work to high standards for documentation and development in the team enabling proactive identification of inefficiencies in existing processes.
The role contributes to shaping standards and best practices, ensuring data is accessible, governed, and aligned with business priorities. They will, alongside their own delivery, guide and develop junior team members — reviewing their analysis and code, providing technical advice, coaching them on controls and documentation. The role contributes to the continuous improvement of data processes, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and clarity in outputs while working within defined guidelines. Communication of findings is clear, structured

Key Responsibilities:

- Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines to validate and transform data to meet actuarial modelling needs.
- Ensure data quality, integrity, and consistency through robust validation, monitoring, and governance practices.
- Collaborate with stakeholders to understand data requirements and translate them into efficient and effective technical solutions.
- Optimise data systems and processes to improve performance, reliability, and scalability.
- Provide technical expertise and guidance on data science approaches, tools, and best practices.
- Support integration of multiple data sources to create cohesive, accessible, and trusted datasets.
- Contribute to the continuous improvement of data platforms, frameworks, and engineering standards.

Key Knowledge, Skills and Experience:

- Strong expertise in data science techniques, including machine learning and their application in financial services.
- Proficiency in data tools, programming languages, and database technologies, in particular in Azure Databricks, Spark, Spark SQL and Python/pyspark.
- Understanding of data governance, security, and data quality management principles.
- Experience working with large, complex datasets and performing feature engineering and data preparation.
- Proven ability to translate business problems into data science solutions and deliver measurable outcomes.
- Strong problem-solving capability with a focus on accuracy and performance.
- Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
- Collaborative approach with the ability to influence decisions and guide others.
- Experience working in Financial Services or a similar heavily audited environment with an understanding of operating controls and producing audit evidence

Essential Skills:

- Data pipeline development and optimisation
- Data modelling and architecture (in Azure Databricks)
- Programming and scripting for data processing (Spark, Spark SQL, Python, pyspark)
- Data science and machine learning
- Data governance and quality assurance
- Problem-solving and analytical thinking
- Stakeholder engagement and technical communication, including at design forums where relevant
- Continuous improvement and innovation
- Performance tuning and optimisation
- People management

Recruiter: Hollie Doran
Role Level: Experienced Colleague
Location: Kildean, Edinburgh, Reading
What we offer:

We’re dedicated to supporting your wellbeing and helping you thrive, both at work and beyond. Our benefits are designed to help you balance your professional and personal life, and financially plan for the future. Our UK benefits include:

- A valuable pension scheme of up to 18% (13% made up of employer contributions and 5% employee contributions).
- Access to our Share Save and Share Incentive Plan, alongside financial wellbeing and support services to help give you real confidence to put your money to work.
- Enjoy 38 days annual leave (including bank holidays), with the opportunity to purchase up to five extra days. Our Time Off When You Need It policy gives you the flexibility - to balance work and personal commitments. 
- Our market-leading Inspiring Families policy includes comprehensive support and paid parental leave covering maternity, adoption, surrogacy, and paternity leave - because supporting families is an important part of our inclusive culture.
- Health & Protection cover includes Private Healthcare, Critical Illness cover and Life Assurance for you, with additional family options - for peace of mind.

To explore more about life at M&G and our full benefits offering, visit Life at M&G

postings.title: Lead Data Engineer
postings.description:
At M&G, our purpose is to give everyone real confidence to put their money to work. With a heritage dating back more than 175 years, we have a long history of innovation in savings and investments, combining asset management and insurance expertise to offer a wide range of solutions. 

Our two distinct operating segments, Asset Management and Life, work together to provide access to balanced, long-term investment and savings solutions.

Through telling it like it is, owning it now and moving it forward together with care and integrity; we are creating an exceptional place to work for exceptional talent.

We will consider flexible working arrangements for any of our roles and offer workplace adjustments to ensure you have the support you need to succeed in your role.

The Opportunity:

Data and AI are at the heart of how we plan to grow our Asset Management business. We are modernising how data is sourced, engineered and consumed across the firm. The goal is trusted, reusable data products that support investment decisions, client reporting, regulatory submissions and a growing range of AI use cases. 

As Lead Data Engineer, you will report to the Head of Data Engineering and be the technical lead for designing and building data products on our Snowflake-centric platform. You will lead data engineers across London and India, turning our architecture and engineering standards into well-engineered, production-ready pipelines and data products. 

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. We want an engineer who still builds, sets the bar for engineering quality and can guide others through complex design decisions. You will be the bridge between our data engineering standards and day-to-day delivery, making sure what we build is scalable, governed and delivers real business outcomes. 

What You will Do:

Design and build on a modern data platform 

- Lead the hands-on design and build of ingestion, transformation and data provisioning pipelines on our Snowflake-centric platform. 

- Apply the medallion architecture in practice, promoting data from raw to curated to consumption-ready layers in line with agreed standards. 

- Translate business and data product requirements into robust technical designs, data models and delivery plans. 

- Build and evolve reusable ingestion, transformation and consumption patterns, whether for BI, APIs, data sharing or AI. 

- Help shape data engineering standards for ELT, orchestration, data modelling, testing, DataOps, CI/CD and observability, working with the Head of Data Engineering. 

Engineer governed, trusted data products 

- Build data quality checks, lineage, cataloguing and data observability into every pipeline and data product from the start, rather than adding them after delivery. 

- Implement data contracts, metadata and certification standards so each data product is discoverable, trusted and auditable. 

- Apply security and compliance by design, including role-based access control, secrets management, encryption, data classification, retention and privacy controls. 

- Make sure pipelines are production-ready, with clear monitoring, alerting and runbooks, and lead root-cause analysis and resolution of data issues. 

Lead and develop data engineers 

- Provide day-to-day technical leadership to data engineers across the UK and India, setting clear priorities and removing blockers. 

- Lead design reviews, code reviews and pairing to raise engineering quality and consistency across the team. 

- Coach and mentor engineers, helping them grow their technical skills and shift from building individual pipelines to delivering reusable data products. 

- Work with offshore engineers as one integrated team, with shared standards, ways of working and ownership. 

Build AI-ready data and use AI in engineering 

- Work with Data Product, Analytics and AI teams to implement semantic models, ensuring business definitions and relationships are consistently represented in the engineered data products. 

- Use AI-assisted tools across the engineering lifecycle, from code generation and testing to documentation and data quality monitoring, with appropriate human oversight. 

Simplify the estate and retire legacy platforms 

- Lead the technical delivery of migrations from legacy data platforms and point-to-point data feeds onto the strategic platform, with data reconciliation and controlled cut-over. 

- Consolidate duplicated pipelines into reusable data products and actively reduce technical debt. 

- Design efficient pipelines and optimise compute and storage so cost efficiency is built into delivery. 

What You will Bring:

- Significant experience in data engineering, including experience as a technical lead within Asset Management or Financial Services. 

- Strong hands-on experience building and optimising data pipelines and data products on Snowflake, ideally in an asset management setting. 

- Solid knowledge of modern data platform architecture, including medallion and lakehouse patterns, ELT and dimensional or domain data modelling. 

- Experience delivering data products end to end, including contributing to semantic layer implementation for analytics and AI use. 

- Practical experience embedding data catalogue, data quality, lineage and data observability tooling into engineering delivery. 

- Good understanding of cloud security, access management, data privacy and regulatory control requirements. 

- Track record of collaborating and building effective relationships with colleagues across data and wider technology function. You should be able to share ownership, manage dependencies and agree joint priorities. 

- Experience leading and mentoring offshore engineering teams as an integrated part of the function, through code reviews, coaching and technical direction and a one-team culture. 

- Experience working in data mesh or hub-and-spoke data operating models. 

- Experience delivering data platform migrations, including data reconciliation and the controlled retirement of legacy feeds while maintaining service continuity. 

- Good understanding of investment data, such as instruments, portfolios, positions and performance, with deeper asset management experience a strong advantage. 

Technical toolkit:

- Snowflake, including Snowpipe, Streams and Tasks, Dynamic Tables and Snowpark 

- Azure, with Databricks exposure an advantage 

- Advanced SQL and Python 

- Data transformation frameworks such as dbt 

- Data pipeline orchestration, Git-based CI/CD and DataOps 

- Streaming, CDC and event-driven integration 

- API, data sharing and consumption patterns 

- Performance tuning and cost optimisation (FinOps) 

- Data catalogue, data quality, lineage and data observability tooling 

- AI-assisted coding and data quality monitoring tools 

Why Join Us:

This is a chance to help build a modern data engineering practice at a pivotal moment for the business. You will be hands-on with the platform and data products at the centre of our data and AI ambitions, while growing your own technical leadership. 

You will see the direct impact of your work on how we invest, serve our clients and operate. If you want to lead from the front, build great data products and help grow a strong team, this is the role. 

Work Level: Manager/Expert 
Location: London 

What we offer:

We’re dedicated to supporting your wellbeing and helping you thrive, both at work and beyond. Our benefits are designed to help you balance your professional and personal life, and financially plan for the future. Our UK benefits include:

- A valuable pension scheme of up to 18% (13% made up of employer contributions and 5% employee contributions).
- Access to our Share Save and Share Incentive Plan, alongside financial wellbeing and support services to help give you real confidence to put your money to work.
- Enjoy 38 days annual leave (including bank holidays), with the opportunity to purchase up to five extra days. Our Time Off When You Need It policy gives you the flexibility - to balance work and personal commitments. 
- Our market-leading Inspiring Families policy includes comprehensive support and paid parental leave covering maternity, adoption, surrogacy, and paternity leave - because supporting families is an important part of our inclusive culture.
- Health & Protection cover includes Private Healthcare, Critical Illness cover and Life Assurance for you, with additional family options - for peace of mind.

The Role: 

Data and AI are at the heart of how we plan to grow our Asset Management business. We are modernising how data is sourced, engineered and consumed across the firm. The goal is trusted, reusable data products that support investment decisions, client reporting, regulatory submissions and a growing range of AI use cases. 

As Head of Data Engineering, you will report to the Director of Data, AI & Analytics and lead a growing data engineering team across London and India. You will own how we ingest, transform, and deliver data. You will be moving us from fragmented, pipeline-by-pipeline delivery to a modern, governed architecture built around data products. 

This is a data engineering leadership role, not a general engineering management role. We want a practitioner who has built modern data platforms hands-on. You should know how to use modern data technologies to design scalable solutions that deliver real business outcomes. 

What You will Do: 

Shape a modern data platform 

- Own the design, build and optimisation of ingestion, transformation and data provisioning on our Snowflake-centric platform. 

- Implement a medallion architecture, with clear standards for promoting data from raw to curated to consumption-ready layers. 

- Set data engineering standards for ELT patterns, orchestration, data modelling, testing, DataOps, CI/CD for data pipelines and observability. 

- Build reusable ingestion, transformation and consumption patterns that speed up access to new data for the business, whether through BI, APIs, data sharing or AI. 

- Take a pragmatic, outcome-led approach, balancing the right data architecture with early business value. 

Deliver governed, trusted data products 

- Make data cataloguing, data quality, lineage and data observability core parts of how every data product is built and run, rather than controls added after delivery. 

- Include data contracts, metadata and certification standards in every data product, so each one is discoverable, trusted and auditable. 

- Ensure data products and pipelines are secure and compliant by design, embedding identity and role-based access control, secrets management, encryption, data classification, retention and privacy controls into engineering standards. 

Build and lead a high-performing data engineering team 

- Lead, inspire and mentor data engineers across the UK and India, and set the standard for how we deliver. 

- Develop the team through regular coaching, clear career pathways and meaningful opportunities to build technical and leadership capability. 

- Shift the team's focus from building individual pipelines to delivering reusable data products, underpinned by strong data modelling, data quality and lineage practices. 

Build AI-ready data and bring AI into data engineering 

- Partner with Data Product, Analytics and AI teams to implement semantic models, ensuring business definitions and relationships are consistently represented in the engineered data products. 

- Apply AI across data engineering, from data quality monitoring and anomaly detection to automated documentation and AI-assisted code, with appropriate human oversight. 

Simplify the estate and retire legacy platforms 

- Lead the technical migration from legacy data platforms and point-to-point data feeds onto the strategic platform. 

- Consolidate duplicated pipelines and fragmented data stores into a smaller set of trusted, reusable data products. 

- Reduce technical debt and keep the data estate simple, supportable and cost-efficient. 

- Build cost awareness into data engineering by designing efficient pipelines and data products and by optimising compute and storage costs as core part of delivery.

- Significant experience in data engineering, including experience leading data engineering teams within Asset Management or Financial Services. 

- Hands-on experience leading Snowflake platform implementation, ideally in an asset management setting. 

- Deep technical knowledge of modern data platform architecture, including medallion and lakehouse patterns, ELT and dimensional or domain data modelling. 

- A track record of designing and delivering data products, including semantic layer implementation for AI and analytics use. 

- Practical experience embedding data governance tooling into delivery, covering data catalogue, data quality, lineage and data observability. 

- Strong understanding of cloud security, data privacy, access management and regulatory control requirements. 

- Track record of collaborating and building effective relationships with colleagues across data and wider technology function. You should be able to share ownership, manage dependencies and agree joint priorities. 

- Experience leading and developing offshore engineering teams as an integrated part of the function, building capability, consistent standards and a one-team culture. 

- Experience working in data mesh or hub-and-spoke data operating models. 

- Good understanding of investment data, such as instruments, portfolios, positions and performance, with deeper asset management experience a strong advantage 

- Experience leading complex data platform migrations and the controlled retirement of legacy platforms while maintaining service continuity. 

Technical toolkit:

- Snowflake, including Snowpipe, Streams and Tasks, Dynamic Tables and Snowpark 

- Azure, with Databricks exposure an advantage 

- Advanced SQL and Python 

- Data transformation frameworks such as dbt 

- Data pipeline orchestration and DataOps / CI/CD for data 

- Advanced SQL, Python and data transformation frameworks 

- Streaming, CDC and event-driven integration 

- API, data sharing and consumption patterns 

- Performance engineering and FinOps 

- Data catalogue, data quality, lineage and data observability tooling 

- AI-assisted data engineering and data quality monitoring tools 

Why Join Us:

This is a chance to shape a data engineering practice at a pivotal moment for the business. Data engineering sits at the centre of our data and AI ambitions, and you will have real influence over how our data platform and data engineering capability develop. 

You will see the direct impact of your work on how we invest, serve our clients and operate. If you want to lead, build and grow a team at the same time, this is the role.
